notes.title: Ranger (0.5)
notes.content:
Ranger Class is here!
Defeat enemies from a distance with Bows, Crossbows, and powerful new abilities unique to the Ranger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571812/bf3aa54e234effd0619ac7ef8f853d097b0326a4.gif[/img]

[h1]New Skills[/h1]
[h2]Pierce Shot[/h2]
Shoot an arrow that pierces and can hit multiple enemies in a row.
Upgrading increases damage and decreases cooldown. 
Occasionally hits very large enemies multiple times. 
Ignores gravity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571812/8d16c5c05801eebed5e451f6a7c28823523903dc.gif[/img]

[h2]Multi Shot[/h2]
Shoots multiple arrows at once
Upgrading increases damage and number of arrows

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571812/e8b9e45c2d4586e6291ccf7bfcad0f07f38a0bb0.gif[/img]

[h2]Root[/h2]
Immobilize targets where you are aiming and deals damage per second
Higher levels can root multiple targets
Level 10 and above deal Poison damage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571812/22f54633b969e2decb9e66c49b549eebc6a72c92.gif[/img]

[h2]Arrow Rain[/h2]
Rain down arrows where you are aiming dealing damage twice per second
Can be interrupted

notes.title: Price Decreased by 25%
notes.content:
Dragon Extinction's price is decreasing by 25% for this phase of Early Access but will be increasing in the future. A few people believe the price was fair as it is, but more people believe the price is a little high for what's currently available. We've decided to decrease the price for now until the game is farther along. We're still working out the details on how to reward customers for purchasing it at the higher price such as giving a choice of legendary item in-game, but let us know your thoughts.

Price Change took place at 2PM CDT Nov 10, 2020

Most of the game can be played with a controller now.
Left Stick controls cursor movement.
